text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation Festival!
To express gratitude for their ongoing cheers,
the Umamusume entertain fans with all kinds of competitions.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming, everyone!
We have programs ready for today, so please be sure to grab one!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Th-Tha— Th-Th-Thi, than—!?
Aaaaaah, Almond Eye!?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
N-No freaking way! Fan Appreciation Day is wild!
The Umamusume of the Year is already out here...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Here are the programs! Go right ahead!
We have plenty, so no need to rush!"

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um-um-um!
What event are you entering, Ai-chan!?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm so glad you asked!
I am—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's about to begin!
This year's most anticipated event—the "Dubai-athlon"!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The "Dubai-athlon" consists of 3 Dubai-themed events
inspired by student suggestion letters!
Look forward to seeing what kind of events they turned out to be♪

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Many different Umamusume have registered for the race,
but the one commanding the most attention is...
none other than this Umamusume right here!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye!! Can the sensational Triple Tiara Umamusume conquer the entire world?!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chaaaaaangh!
Do your beeeeeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yay♡
Ai-san is really here!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: When you think of Dubai, you think of this Umamusume—Vivlos! With a Dubai GⅠ victory under her belt and a huge love for Dubai, many are calling her today's top favorite!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for joining in~!
Thanks to you, it's definitely gonna be super hyped♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Saying thank you, huh...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I put in a suggestion!
Saying, "Let's spice up the Fan Appreciation Festival
with a celebrity flair through Dubai-style sports!"♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: On my love for Dubai! I won't lose~!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Me too!
Whatever the event is, I'm going all out to win!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
All participants, please gather at the starting line!
—We will be starting shortly!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And they're off! Almond Eye
gets a great start! First, she charges across
the dirt representing the desert, dragging a tire behind her!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I get the desert part, but...
the tire has nothing to do with Dubai, right...?!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's with that massive tire...?! Umamusume are unbelievable...

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—And now, let's bring you live coverage!
Next up is a jewel hunt in the pool area, themed after Dubai's grand river!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Found some sparklies~♪
First one here~♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Me too... Um...
Ah! That big, brilliant one—I like that one!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Wait, that's completely wrong!

And so, despite the hectic nature of it all,
Almond Eye ran in around 5th or 6th place—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!
This is the last event, isn't it...――

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
This is VR space! Inside visuals modeled after a Dubai skyscraper,
you'll rappel down a long glass wall using ropes!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I-It's so high...! And windy, too...
This is an incredible recreation...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hnngh... heeeave...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (Vivlos is already that far down the stretch...! Running normally won't be enough to catch her——)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Even so—I have no choice but to go!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!
Almond Eye scrambled down the glass wall using a rope at an incredible speed. The result was—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪
First plaaace♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...I was so close...!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, maybe it's the difference in our love for Dubai~?
So you see, right, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna hand over 1st place in Dubai to anyone♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...I will definitely get my revenge!
Afterward, while taking a break with Almond Eye and checking out the attractions at the Fan Appreciation Festival—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —In that case!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Almond Eye makes her move—
Wait, WHAAAAT!?
She jumped offーー!?

Even if it's VR space, it's quite high up.
It must take incredible courage to jump off...
Yet, without a moment's hesitation, she leans forward—
(Tah-dah!!)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye breaks clear, Almond Eye breaks clear!! With a phenomenal late charge, Almond Eye closes in for a magnificent victory! She takes on the world and wins!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I did it...!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ai-san, that was amazing...!
Weren't you scared?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Just a little bit!
Still, I had no other choice."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Losing is way scarier than that!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...I think maybe, someday, I'd like to
go to Dubai together with Ai-san?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"If I can beat you, I feel like...
I'll become even more sparkling ♪"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Someday, let's definitely race again!
And when we do, I'll be the one to win!
Afterward, while taking a break with Almond Eye and checking out the attractions at the Fan Appreciation Festival—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Found you,
Ai-senpai!

The ones who called out were the Umamusume from the generation right below Almond Eye—
Gran Alegria and Loves Only You.

"Chrono Genesis, Curren Bouquetd'or...
All of them are aiming for the Tiara route and are about to challenge the Oka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
U-Um...!
I watched the Dubai Athlon...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-The final event got all the buzz, but
that first dirt race was amazing too...!
It really showed how well-rounded of an athlete Ai-san is...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
So many people were cheering for
Ai-san...
I was amazed by the sheer intensity of their passion.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
We should put on races that captivate lots of people
just like Ai-san does...
Listen to me get all passionate, haha♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I appreciate your respect, but—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"—'Please don't look up to me', right?
Of course, we're fully prepared for that!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Unless we defeat you in a direct showdown...
our era will never come!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
――That's one more thing to look forward to!

I watched Almond Eye interact with her juniors from a short distance away.
Just as I was admiring the heartwarming scene—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye always draws
so much attention.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is drawn to her, I suppose.
Fans, juniors... and even rivals.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Almond-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I knew it, she really is the one...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
――Almond Eye is truly
at the center of this current era.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, honestly... is that really enough
for a proper evaluation?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In every era that came after mine,
there was always an Umamusume who stood at its center.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "However... she gives off an impression entirely unlike any other Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I am still in the process of putting it into words.
However, what is certain is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It means that right now, she is beginning to change something...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to serve her with all your heart.
As her Trainer—for the sake of the future.
